title: Guest Refund Policy: Cancellation Windows and Nightly Refunds on Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Guest Refund Policy — when a guest cancels

These terms decide the nightly refund when a guest cancels a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category.

## Terms

1. **When a guest may cancel.** A guest may cancel a confirmed stay at any time before check-in, or a checked-in stay at any time before the check-out date.
2. **Dates and counting.** The cancellation date is the date part of the cancellation time recorded on the stay. Days before check-in are counted as whole calendar days from the cancellation date to the check-in date.
3. **Which policy decides.** The refund is decided by the stay's cancellation policy as recorded on the stay, never by the listing's current setting.
4. **Non-refundable rate.** A stay at the non-refundable rate gets the policy's non-refundable refund percentage of every component on a guest cancellation, with no further window.
5. **Standard rate, before check-in — order of windows.** The windows are tested in this order and the first one met applies:
   - **Booking grace period.** Met when the guest cancels no more than the policy's grace period in elapsed hours after the reservation was booked. Grace hours are counted as elapsed clock time from the booking time to the cancellation time, never as calendar days, and a policy whose grace period is 0 hours has no grace period. The booking grace period also requires the cancellation date to fall at least the policy's grace minimum lead in calendar days before the stay's check-in date.
   - **Full-refund window.** Met when the cancellation date falls at least the policy's full-refund cutoff in calendar days before the stay's check-in date; a policy whose cutoff is 0 has no full-refund window.
   - In the grace period or the full-refund window every component is refunded in full, the guest service fee included when the policy refunds it in full in those windows.
   - **Partial-refund window.** Met when the cancellation date falls at least the policy's partial-window cutoff in calendar days before the check-in date and neither earlier window is met. A partial-window cutoff of 0 means the partial window runs up to and including the day before check-in, and also covers a cancellation dated on the check-in date before the stay is checked in. In the partial window the first forfeited nights of the policy are never refunded and the policy's partial refund percentage of the remaining nights' price is refunded.
   - A standard-rate cancellation before check-in that meets no window refunds no nightly amount.
6. **After check-in.** The unspent nights are those dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date; the first notice nights of the policy are forfeited and the policy's after-check-in refund percentage of the rest is refunded.
7. **Night price.** One night's price is the nightly subtotal divided by the nights, rounded to the cent.

The moments that decide every window are the booking time, the cancellation time and the check-in date recorded on the stay.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Test | Facts | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Grace hours, 48-hour grace period | booked 2026-04-01 14:00, cancelled 2026-04-03 14:00 (48 elapsed hours) | hours condition met |
| Grace hours, 48-hour grace period | booked 2026-04-01 14:00, cancelled 2026-04-03 14:01 | not met |
| Grace lead, 14-day minimum, check-in 2026-04-20 | cancellation dated 2026-04-06 (14 days before) | lead condition met |
| Grace lead, same stay | cancellation dated 2026-04-07 (13 days before) | not met |
| Full-refund window, 14-day cutoff, check-in day D | cancellation dated D minus 14 | met |
| Full-refund window, same stay | cancellation dated D minus 13 | not met |
| Partial window, cutoff 0 | cancellation dated on the check-in date, stay not yet checked in | partial window applies |

## Worked refunds (hypothetical stays)

- **Partial window.** A 5-night stay with a nightly subtotal of 750.00 under a policy with a 5-day full-refund cutoff, a partial-window cutoff of 0, 1 forfeited night and a 50.00% partial refund is cancelled 3 calendar days before check-in. The full-refund window is missed and the partial window applies. One night's price is 150.00; 1 night is forfeited; 50.00% of the remaining 4 nights' price, 600.00, is 300.00.
- **After check-in.** A 4-night stay with a nightly subtotal of 600.00 under a policy with 1 notice night and a 100.00% after-check-in refund is cancelled on the day after check-in. Nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date: 2. One is forfeited as notice; 100.00% of the other night's price, 150.00, is refunded.
